name: the-fire-department
why: Opens on the Fed producing the Great Depression within sixteen years of 1913, escalates through a hosed bubble and 9,000 banks falling like dominoes, and pays off with its fire truck parking by a burning bank and writing it a ticket (68 s).

name: four-trillion-frosting
why: Opens on the Fed cranking a $4 trillion mountain in one year, finds every government's $4.5 billion trial budget as a pebble at its foot, and pays off on the fat cat green with frosting next to two bars of exactly the same height, wearing a ROBUST RECOVERY sash.

name: the-fake-nobel-prize
why: About 71 seconds that open on Wishonia bouncing over 'The Fake Nobel Prize' and pay off with Nobel's skeleton losing its jaw, the Nobel website's own denial, and the press pinning the medal on a burglar.
